cases.name: r3-control-replay-keeps-source-allocation
cases.selectionRationale: Reject unchanged source allocation IDs and omission of the real Kernel Begin call. Require fresh matching positives, whole-mutant compilation and the designated semantic assertion. Timeouts, frontend errors and unrelated failures are not evidence.

cases.name: r3-control-replay-skips-executable-begin
cases.selectionRationale: Verify the kernel_replay module and its name-preparation child module with the pinned verifier module filter. The full Rust method name is rooted at Kernel, while its defining timing module is kernel_replay. Require the exact replay_one control-step assertion to fail; retain strict scope, positive-baseline, compiling-mutant and diagnostic checks.
